## Power Sessions 0.1.2

Pin the sessions you are watching above the list, collapse Sessions like Quick actions, and edit actions without the form being cut off.

- Pin a session with the pin beside its row: its details stay open under Pinned, above Sessions. Pins stay in sync across workspaces.
- Sessions collapses and expands like Quick actions, and remembers its state.
- The panel scrolls as one column, so Quick actions sit right under Sessions and the edit form is never cut off.
- An active session shows a static green dot in its details instead of a spinner.
- The button beside Sessions is now a refresh button. It closes open details, except pinned ones, and reloads.

No new plugin capabilities. Updates install without re-approval.
